bugs.root_cause: Missing deterministic conversational fast path for common greetings in Tier 0 router, causing unnecessary expensive LLM calls.
bugs.fix: Implemented Tier 0 regex fast path (<1ms) in FridayBrain and semantic router prioritizing greetings.

bugs.root_cause: Greedy regex in app launcher matched entire multi-clause prompt string as target application name.
bugs.fix: Implemented CompoundIntentParser decomposing commands into sequential PEOV DAG missions.

bugs.root_cause: Physical acoustic microphone-to-speaker transducer roundtrip requires physical workstation hardware.
bugs.fix: Implemented robust programmatic VAD, RingBuffer, Faster-Whisper and Kokoro TTS fallbacks with graceful error handling.

bugs.root_cause: Process termination skills lacked protected process deny-list, exposing critical OS binaries to termination.
bugs.fix: Enforced PROTECTED_SYSTEM_PROCESSES fence blocking termination of 15 critical Windows binaries (csrss.exe, lsass.exe, etc.).

bugs.root_cause: Approval tokens were stateless without single-use consumption invalidation, enabling replay attacks.
bugs.fix: Implemented single-use cryptographic token consumption and immediate memory purging in SecurityGate.

bugs.root_cause: Relative path resolution allowed directory traversal escapes outside authorized workspace boundaries.
bugs.fix: Enforced canonical Path(path).resolve() normalization and system root containment boundaries.

bugs.root_cause: Agent state machine lacked thread synchronization, risking state corruption under rapid concurrent transitions.
bugs.fix: Wrapped all state transitions and history logging in threading.RLock() with strict transition table validation.

bugs.root_cause: Application close command reported success immediately after dispatching close message without verifying HWND destruction.
bugs.fix: Added postcondition verification polling loop checking psutil process status and uiautomation HWND with taskkill fallback.

bugs.root_cause: Standalone text entry commands routed to LLM dialogue instead of native UI text injection.
bugs.fix: Added Tier 1 fast-path interceptor for typing verbs directly invoking UITypeTextSkill.

bugs.root_cause: Loose fuzzy phonetics caused misheard 'mute' command to toggle or unmute audio.
bugs.fix: Implemented strict phonetic regex isolating 'mute' from 'unmute' directives.

bugs.root_cause: Screenshot capture reported success without verifying that the image file was physically written to disk.
bugs.fix: Added independent file existence check, byte size inspection, and PIL image load verification.

bugs.root_cause: Missing PDF title metadata caused model to hallucinate titles from prior training knowledge.
bugs.fix: Implemented zero-trust PDF metadata parsing returning truthful unverified status when metadata is absent.

bugs.root_cause: Large documents overflowed model context limit, triggering provider HTTP 400 errors or OOM crashes.
bugs.fix: Enforced strict context budget capping extraction to 2500 tokens with representative page chunking.

bugs.root_cause: Documents containing words like 'cpu' mistakenly triggered system hardware telemetry skill instead of document analysis.
bugs.fix: Added negative lookbehinds in telemetry regex and prioritized attached document inspection.

bugs.root_cause: Generative writing directives lacked multi-stage planning for generation followed by typing.
bugs.fix: Added is_generative_writing classifier in CompoundIntentParser producing 5-step dependent DAGs.

bugs.root_cause: File save skill was unregistered in certain execution paths.
bugs.fix: Registered SaveFileSkill with explicit PEOV pre/postcondition verification.

bugs.root_cause: Truncated HTTP streams failed silently, leading LLM to hallucinate missing page contents.
bugs.fix: Enforced zero-hallucination error propagation: aborted HTTP streams return structured failure notice.

bugs.root_cause: Web queries occasionally answered from model internal memory rather than live network extraction.
bugs.fix: Enforced live DOM fetching via httpx with unique nonce verification.

bugs.root_cause: Model routing decisions were opaque without confidence metrics or telemetry logging.
bugs.fix: Implemented RouteResult dataclass with structured confidence score, tier assignment, and audit logs.

bugs.root_cause: Skills returned success immediately after calling OS APIs without checking physical side-effects.
bugs.fix: Enforced PEOV (Precondition, Execute, Observe, Verify, Rollback) architecture across all skills.

bugs.root_cause: DOCX edits rewrote entire document, corrupting complex formatting, headers, and tables.
bugs.fix: Built DocxStructuralParser with numbered item indexing and surgical in-place paragraph mutation.

bugs.root_cause: Deep research query on complex topics hung indefinitely in 'ACTIVE // THINKING' due to missing terminal state reset, un-supervised coroutine, un-cancellable worker, and socket keep-alive stall.
bugs.fix: Refactored research into thread-safe DeepResearchWorker(QThread) managed by TaskSupervisor with watchdog timeouts, GUI stop-button cancellation, streaming signals, and guaranteed idle state resets in finally blocks.

bugs.root_cause: Legacy voice loop routed spoken utterances to execute_smart_skill bypassing query_llm, creating divergent tool architectures for voice vs chat.
bugs.fix: Replaced execute_smart_skill with direct await query_llm(stream_to_ui=True, stream_to_speech=True), achieving 100% architectural parity.

bugs.root_cause: Voice loop slept while TTS was speaking, preventing acoustic barge-in interruption.
bugs.fix: Integrated VoiceInterruptionController checking microphone RMS frame energy against baseline threshold, stopping TTS immediately upon speech onset.

bugs.root_cause: Internal model thoughts (<think>...</think>) and tool fences ([TOOL: ...]) leaked to spoken audio.
bugs.fix: Implemented strict regex sanitization stripping thinking blocks, tool traces, code fences, and emojis prior to TTS synthesis.

bugs.root_cause: Pre-roll audio buffer inclusion caused brief transient key clicks (<50ms) to pass duration threshold (>200ms).
bugs.fix: Calculated speech duration strictly between speech onset and offset timestamps, discarding transient clicks.

bugs.root_cause: Stopping voice loop while reader thread was blocked inside PyAudio stream.read() triggered use-after-close C panic.
bugs.fix: Added reader synchronization event waiting up to 3.0s for clean thread exit before closing PortAudio stream.

bugs.root_cause: Acoustic speaker rebounds caused immediate duplicate execution of voice commands.
bugs.fix: Implemented TranscriptDeduplicator with 2.5s temporal suppression window and punctuation normalization.

bugs.root_cause: TTS synthesis failure or missing audio device caused text response to disappear or left HUD in permanent SPEAKING state.
bugs.fix: Wrapped TTS invocation in try/finally blocks guaranteeing assistant text bubble is committed to UI and state resets to idle.

bugs.root_cause: Circular import between friday_core.memory.manager and skill registry via mission_store prevented memory module initialization.
bugs.fix: Lazy-imported mission_store inside get_task_memory() and protected annotations with TYPE_CHECKING.

bugs.root_cause: Python blindly injected vector knowledge snippets into user prompts before the Main Agent Model could evaluate intent.
bugs.fix: Eliminated unprompted knowledge injection; Main Agent Model is now the sole decision-maker via query_knowledge_base tool.

bugs.root_cause: Main Agent Model had no native OpenAPI tool schema to query local RAG knowledge base on demand.
bugs.fix: Added query_knowledge_base OpenAPI schema and dispatch handler in AgentToolBridge.

bugs.root_cause: Database rebuild failed with Windows file lock error (WinError 32) when PRAGMA failed on a corrupt DB file.
bugs.fix: Restructured connection context manager with outer try/finally guaranteeing conn.close() and explicit garbage collection.

bugs.root_cause: Lack of knowledge domain segregation allowed cross-domain contamination between Project, Personal, Tech, and Research data.
bugs.fix: Added KnowledgeDomain enum, domain indexing, schema migration, and strict domain query filtering.

bugs.root_cause: Re-ingesting the same file created duplicate chunks in vector database, bloating results and wasting context.
bugs.fix: Added SHA-256 doc_hash and content_hash computation preventing duplicate chunk insertions.

bugs.root_cause: Updating a memory fact did not increment versioning, creating risks of stale memory dominance.
bugs.fix: Implemented auto-version increment (v1 -> v2) and marked superseded records historical.

bugs.root_cause: Memory deletion claimed success without checking physical absence in the database.
bugs.fix: Added immediate readback verification after SQL DELETE; returns True only if absence is confirmed.

bugs.root_cause: Synchronous psutil.cpu_percent(interval=0.1) in get_cpu_info blocked thread for 100ms, starving Qt event loop.
bugs.fix: Migrated to non-blocking psutil.cpu_percent(interval=None) with initial priming. Latency dropped from 100.86ms to 0.06ms.

bugs.root_cause: safe_calculate return type discrepancy between raw float and natural language string in verification assertions.
bugs.fix: Standardized assertions to verify natural language response while ensuring zero eval() injection vulnerability.

bugs.root_cause: ImageContextManager registration method signature discrepancy in test fixtures.
bugs.fix: Bound registration directly to store_context(ImageContext) with verified FIFO 20-slot eviction capacity.

bugs.root_cause: DeepResearchWorker constructor requires TaskRecord from TaskSupervisor; direct invocation caused un-supervised workers.
bugs.fix: Integrated worker creation through task_supervisor.create_task(), guaranteeing supervision and clean cancellation.
